activeMap.name: Rooftop Map
activeMap.description: Elevated rooftop battlefield with stairwell chokepoints and ramp entries. Replaced the flat Square Arena as part of a major update that also shipped a new zombie movement system.
activeMap.devQuote: I launched the first part of the update with the new map and new zombie movement system. — Santito, 2026-04-18
activeMap.communityVote: 215 YES vs 14 NO to replace Square Arena (94% approval)

faq.question: What map is active now?
faq.answer: Rooftop Map since April 18, 2026. Replaced Square Arena with stairwell chokepoints and new zombie movement.

faq.question: How many maps exist?
faq.answer: Rooftop is the confirmed standard arena. Atlantis is media-reported live during Galactic Event, but Roblox official page text did not name it in the May 26 check.

faq.question: Does Rooftop Map cause lag?
faq.answer: Known issue — post-launch poll showed 242/300 players reporting lower FPS. Lower Roblox graphics as workaround.

faq.question: Best class for Rooftop Map?
faq.answer: Tactician for structural lane locks; Necromancer for funnel Death Nova. Both outperform Square Arena counterparts.

faq.question: Will there be more maps?
faq.answer: Atlantis is media-reported live for the Galactic Event. Treat Rooftop as the standard confirmed arena until in-game checks or patch notes confirm rotation rules.
